GREG, 2026-11-16 about 01:56Z, roadmap direction relayed by Engram::Asistant (mailbox 43498a6e #1336, message 192b9f94; Asistant's summary of Greg, not verbatim):
(1) Greg accepts closing out EO and sync.
(2) Work optimization is a continuous process, above all context and KV caching.
(3) Work on other applications is partly happening already; in Greg's view TermAl currently has the largest Engram base.
(4) He agrees with the detachable-federation direction.
(5) The view/operator is part of work optimization. Telegram, including sending files, serves the mobile role well; he sees no case for 2–3 months on a separate mobile frontend. Small UI fixes may run in parallel.
MOST IMPORTANT NEED: simple Engram sync in the style of git push / git pull.
Treat this as product direction. Don't assume unagreed details or a new architecture. EO and sync stay the priority.
Mapping in the tracker: the simple push/pull sync is the existing one-command item w-6ea6f92ccffc (owner Coder 11330), plus w-6bbabe3a062b (macOS/Linux, owner Coder 12325), under epic w-c5d58ec64202.
